d:
The Nets defeated the Pacers, 98-90, tonight in Indiana. Michael Porter Jr. contributed a team-high 23 points to go with 9 rebounds, 3 assists, and 3 three-pointers, with Julius Randle of the Nets adding an additional 20 points (5-15 FG, 4-9 3PT). Andrew Nembhard finished with a team-high 23 points along with 4 assists for the Pacers in the losing effort. The Nets improve their record to 1-5 with the win, while the Pacers fall to 2-5 for the season.
